item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 29/Jul/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A broad trough of low pressure will continue to bring showers and thunderstorms to the coast of southern China tomorrow. Under the influence of a southwesterly airstream, the weather will be hot over the region in the latter part of this week, but there will still be showers. With the southwesterly airstream becoming active and under the influence of the upper-air disturbances, the weather will be unsettled over the coast of Guangdong during the weekend to early next week. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Co-May will move across the East China Sea in general direction of the vicinity of the coast of eastern China in the next couple of days.
